evidence.node_22_20_change: Node.js 22.20.0 moved official Node 22 builds to OpenSSL 3.5.2 so the line could remain supported beyond OpenSSL 3.0 EOL.

affected_assessment.reason: The current wrapper pins Node 22.16.0, predating the Node 22.20.0 OpenSSL 3.5.2 transition. The new prevention gate directly probes process.versions.openssl from the built candidate so promotion cannot rely on version inference alone.

customer_impact: No production exposure is claimed because the candidate remains staging-only and not production-approved. Promotion with an EOL cryptographic runtime would create unsupported future security-fix risk.
containment: keep 0.6.76 promotion blocked while deployment/security gates fail
require the approved Node 22.23.2 digest-pinned base or a later explicitly reviewed Node 22 security release
require a non-root runtime and exact manifest/image agreement
do not weaken the encrypted-bootstrap or runtime provenance gates to accelerate promotion

regression_test.pass_condition: OpenSSL is at least 3.5.2 and is not on the 3.0 line

steps: rebase encrypted bootstrap onto digest-pinned Node 22.23.2 bookworm-slim
create/chown runtime extraction directory before USER node
run bootstrap and runtime integrity tests against the exact encrypted artifact
run staging browser/customer proof for the exact candidate
promote only if all gates pass and main has not moved incompatibly
